verified_source_facts: JAX StreamingCheckpointer.load_trainstate_checkpoint can load trainstate:: streaming checkpoints when the expected target/config and dependencies exist.
The official checkpoint repository contains streaming_train_state, metadata.pkl and dataset.pkl rather than a native Hugging Face PyTorch weight package.
The pinned PyTorch reference implementation exposes test-time state/update tensors but its README instantiates from config and points the tokenizer at meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf.
The JAX training/evaluation flags also default tokenizer_name to meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf.
